description: Audit one public web page for visibility in Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity. Fetches the page as the AI search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) to catch robots.txt, CDN and firewall blocks, checks how much content exists without JavaScript, and scores extractability and trust signals. Free preview returns the readiness score, grade, and list of critical issues, along with a direct payment link to unlock the repository code fix pack. Paid (pass token from seoaeogeo.app/account after unlocking): the coding-agent fix pack with Change / Where / Verify for every issue. Takes 10–30 seconds.

question.description: Optional: the question this page should win in AI answers, e.g. "best CRM for small agencies". Adds query-level fit (heading match, answer-first for the question, names, price and date present); changes no score.

token.description: Optional MCP token from https://seoaeogeo.app/account after a paid unlock. Without it, the response is the free preview (score and issue names only).

url.description: The page to audit, e.g. https://example.com/pricing

name: audit_url
title: Audit a page for Google and AI search
